summary: Master pension fund risk metrics, performance attribution, and reporting standards. Learn to optimize fund solvency and report to stakeholders with confidence.
lede: Investment risk and return metrics for pension funds measure portfolio results against benchmarks, risk and long-term liabilities. For pension fund analysts, portfolio managers, trustees and risk officers, the course addresses the practical task of assessing performance and communicating it for oversight. It covers return measurement, risk-adjusted benchmarking and attribution, with exercises in ALM-aligned allocation, tail-risk analysis and stress-testing with Monte Carlo simulations.
audienceIntro: This course is essential for professionals responsible for the financial integrity and performance reporting of institutional retirement schemes.
audience: Performance Measurement Specialists focused on attribution
modules: Pension Fund Solvency and ALM Foundations
Alternative Assets and ESG Risk Integration
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of financial markets and basic statistical concepts (mean, standard deviation). Experience working within a pension fund, investment firm, or actuarial practice is highly recommended. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel for financial modeling is required, as several exercises involve complex formula construction. No prior programming knowledge is necessary.
